decisions.reason: As a niche marine product with likely certification and project-based demand, submarine interior lighting would usually be retained for its long lifecycle unless sales were clearly weak.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires fit a durable B2B niche and the 2019 LED replacement kit indicates ongoing platform investment rather than withdrawal.
The relaunch of a popular designer task light suggests established demand, though it is somewhat less central to an industrial lighting portfolio than the specialist technical lines.
A pendant office luminaire is strategically close to a commercial lighting core business, but as a recent launch it still faces some rationalization risk if demand or differentiation disappoints.

The premium pendant luminaire likely has a narrower market and possible overlap with other office pendant products, but a large established manufacturer would usually give such a 2019 launch more time before discontinuing it.
